messages:
pagerduty: ⚠️ PagerDuty alert: 5xx spike on /v2/generate in us-west-2 starting ~3309991200. Service error rate ~12% over baseline.

Emma (oncall): Acknowledged. Moving to #incidents. Triage in progress. What's the customer impact?

Maria: Support: 4 enterprise customers reporting 502/504 on chat/generate. Tickets opened, CS notified. No evidence of data exposure.

Leo: Pulling pod logs from failing runner pods — looks like big allocations during model load.

Leo: ```
[runner] allocate_weights() failed: std::bad_alloc
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Backtrace:
  run_model()+0x1f4
  main()+0x3c
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

ops-bot: autoscaler: inference-pool-usw2 scaled 4 -> 10. New pods show repeated OOMKilled during init (model load). Kube events: Evicted, OOMKilled on several nodes.

Emma (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan:
- reduce regional traffic to us-west-2 by 60% via fast-fail routing
- enable circuit-breaker on model-runner ingress (max concurrent per-pod = 4)
- pin affected customers to smaller model variant (redwood-model-lite:v1)
- roll back model-runner canary deployed ~3309989000

Sam: I'll update the status page: "Partial degradation in us-west-2: elevated 5xx; mitigation underway."

Leo: Propose hotpatch to disable aggressive KV prefetch and lower model load threads: `KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0 MODEL_LOAD_THREADS=2`. That should reduce memory pressure during init.

Leo: Applying env patch: `kubectl -n infra set env ds/model-runner KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0 MODEL_LOAD_THREADS=2` — rolling out to nodes now.

autoscaler: provisioning additional capacity in us-east-1 for rerouted traffic.

Maria: CS has sent temporary guidance to impacted customers (retries, reduced concurrency).

ops-bot: routing config applied: 60% reroute to us-east-1. Observability: error rate in us-west-2 dropped to ~6% within 90s. Latency on routed region is stable.

Emma (oncall): Initiating rollback of the canary. Leo, pause any further binary changes until rollback verified.

Leo: Rollback job started: infra/rollback-330999. Watching pod termination and stable image rollout.

ops-bot: Rollback complete. Stable pods are up. Crash count per node decreased to 0-1. Global endpoint 5xx rate back to ~1.5%.

Emma (oncall): Verified pinned customers are on the lite variant and errors have subsided. CS to confirm ticket closures. Handoff to Tom for watch and post-incident write-up.

Tom (oncall-night): Taking over. I'll do a 1-hour watch and kick off the RCA doc. Created ticket infra-330999-oom-rca. Initial hypothesis: canary introduced heavier model binary/load pattern combined with KV prefetching caused memory exhaustion on nodes with marginal headroom.

Sam: Status page updated: mitigation complete; root cause investigation ongoing. :thumbsup:

Maria: Closing customer outreach loop after final verification. CS to follow up with logs and timeline.

pagerduty: Incident mitigated and resolved at 3309994560. Pager closed. Please include timeline, actions (rollback, reroute, hotpatch), and follow-ups in the postmortem.
